page.layout: One printed page: title page. Full-width title lines at top; a woodcut device in the centre; imprint lines below the device. Handwritten numeral at top right is not printed.
page.notes: Woodcut device (an emblem with a hand and flames within an ornamental border) between the title and the imprint; not transcribed. Handwritten "2" and a mark at top right are manuscript annotations, not print. Title line "GRAMMA-" has its first letter decorated; the "G" is partly obscured by a stain. Long s rendered as plain s in "Basileensis"; "GRAECAE" and "PRAECEPTA" printed with the ligatured/archaic forms as shown ("GRAÆCAE" set as printed "GRAECAE").
